description: This file defines a React context and provider for managing and caching user and session data within a React application. It includes hooks for consuming the context and functions for fetching data from API endpoints, with state management for loading and error states.

methods.name: useDataContext
methods.description: Hook to consume the shared DataContext providing cached user and session data.

methods.name: DataProvider
methods.description: React component that loads, caches, and provides user and session data, along with loading and error states, to its children.
